g.text: A large repo can hit the rate limit of GitHub in the middle of a sync. The sync then
stopped, and the list showed old data.
* The sync waits until the limit resets, then reads the page again.
* A second failure stops the sync with an error.
tests for the 403 and the 429 replies.
